info.title: TLV Parking
info.description: Tel Aviv-Yafo parking lots with estimated prices for a time window. Times are Asia/Jerusalem. Prices are estimates; the sign at the gate prevails. Coverage: Ahuzot HaHof municipal lots, Central Park, Green Parking, Azrieli, Dizengoff Center and Sarona with prices; other public lots (city license registry, OpenStreetMap) with price_ils null.

get.summary: Parking lots near a place, ranked by estimated price for the time window

parameters.name: near
parameters.description: Place or address, Hebrew or English, e.g. 'Dizengoff Center' or 'דיזנגוף 50'

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Entry time, local, e.g. 2026-10-10T14:00. Default: now.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: The user's TLV residential parking permit zone (blue-white parking there is free)

parameters.name: apps
parameters.description: Comma list: pango,cello,moovit,centralpark (centralpark = Central Park in-app price)

parameters.name: transit
parameters.description: 1 = will ride a TLV bus the same day

200.description: resolved_location, query, street (blue-white curbside parking at the point: zone, price_ils, chance_pct estimate; null outside TLV zones), results[] (price_ils null = price on sign), caveats[]

get.summary: One lot: tariffs, original Hebrew tariff text, hours, offers, live status, quote, links
Place or address to coordinates (ambiguous names return several)
